sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN l.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS percentage_female FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 55
